State the research question in one paragraph. Name the gap in the
literature and the contribution the study will make.

# Objectives

State the objectives. Make each objective specific and testable.

# Methodology

Describe the method. Name the data, the collection approach, and
the analysis technique.

# Timeline

Give the milestones with their dates. Use a table.

# Resources

State the resources needed: funding, equipment, and access.
